decisionsTitle: Every discount code says who it is for: chosen levels or «Toți membrii», never by leaving it empty (amending §811 and §817)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19:** «Și fiecare cod de reducere trebuie să fie pentru un anumit nivel de membru.»

**Decision (amends §811 and §817; no new rule beyond one sentence).** Every code names who it is for, chosen explicitly: one or more levels, or the chip **«Toți membrii»** (members with or without a level). Nothing ticked is no longer «every member»: the club must choose, and a code is saved only when it has. The chips' legend is «Pentru cine e codul» (it was «Pentru nivelurile»); «Toți membrii» is the first chip, posted as its own `forAll` (kept out of the list of level ids), and it excludes the levels — with scripts on, ticking it clears the levels and ticking a level clears it; on a page with no script a post with both is refused on the chips' box, as is a post with neither, each in its own words. A new code starts with nothing ticked; a code saved before this shows «Toți membrii» ticked.

**The stored meaning does not change.** «Toți membrii» is stored as the column's existing null, levels as the list of ids, so every code already saved reads as «Toți membrii», the zone's filter (`codeIsForTier`, the SQL in `listDiscountCodesForMembers`) is untouched, a member with no level still sees the «Toți membrii» codes alone, and there is no migration. A Redactor's save still keeps the stored choice whatever is posted. Every code's line in the editor now says «Pentru: Toți membrii» or «Pentru: <levels>», always. While the club has named no level there is nothing to choose between, so the form draws no chips and posts «Toți membrii» itself.

**Refused:** a default of «Toți membrii» on a new code (the owner asked for a choice, and a default is the old behaviour under another name); a new column or a sentinel value in the id list; grouping the editor's list by audience (the list is ordered by hand with up and down, and a group would fight that order).
changelogLine: - **Every discount code says who it is for** — the codes' chips «Pentru cine e codul» start with «Toți membrii», then the levels; one of the two must be ticked, never both, and each code's line says «Pentru: …»; codes already saved read as «Toți membrii», nothing a member sees changes. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 168: a discount code is saved only when the club chose who it is for — one or more member levels, or «Toți membrii» — and a post that chose neither, or both, is refused on the chips' box `tierIds`; «Toți membrii» is stored as no limit, so a code saved before the choice was explicit is for every member, a member with no level sees only those, a Redactor's save keeps the choice as stored, and each code's line in the editor says «Pentru: Toți membrii» or «Pentru: <levels>» (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
